title: Check Claude CLI availability
responsibility: Checks the installed Claude CLI and subscription sign-in, then reports the configured model choice.

inputs.name: claudeState.command
inputs.description: The executable and initial arguments for Claude CLI. The helper appends version and JSON authentication-status commands, each with a ten-second timeout.

outputs.name: claudeState
outputs.description: A promise for Claude availability, version, reason and model choices. A logged-in claude.ai subscription enables the configured Claude Opus 5.5 choice with low through max effort and xhigh as default. Image generation remains false. Discovery failures return unavailable with a reason and no models.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The subscription requirement can produce an Error internally, but this function catches it and reports its message in the returned unavailable state. Normal discovery errors are not rethrown.
